title: 3rd Sitting of 1st Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/3/1/2025).
Approval of the minutes of three previous special sittings (minutes Nos. 20/2025/ޚޞ/1 to 20/2025/ޚޞ/3).

Question from Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir to Minister of Fisheries and Ocean Resources Ahmed Shiyam: what is being done to secure a sustainable income for those who live off skipjack, kawakawa and frigate tuna, dried and cooked fish, reef fishing and other fisheries, and why are fishers in some sectors denied the fuel subsidy, creating discrimination between fisheries?

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nomination for Permanent Representative to the International Maritime Organization (Constitution Article 115(d), Foreign Service Act, Law No. 20/2021, Article 14) is sent to the relevant standing committee.
From the Speaker's desk: the President's nomination for Permanent Representative to the International Renewable Energy Agency is sent to the relevant standing committee.
From the Speaker's desk: the President's nomination for Permanent Representative to the World Trade Organization is sent to the relevant standing committee.
From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominations for Non-Resident Ambassadors to Canada and the Arab Republic of Egypt are sent to the relevant standing committee.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission on appointing the Vice President of the Anti-Corruption Commission (Anti-Corruption Commission Act, Law No. 13/2008, Article 7(b)) is sent to the relevant standing committee.
From the Speaker's desk: Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim's proposal to amend the Majlis Rules of Procedure (under Article 272(c) of the Rules) is sent to the relevant standing committee.
Preliminary debate on the Bill amending the Decentralisation Act (Law No. 7/2010), submitted on behalf of the government by Machchangoalhi Central MP Ahmed Zameer.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Bill on Prevention of Gang Crimes and Other Serious Crimes, submitted on behalf of the government by Machchangoalhi South MP Mustafa Hussain.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to question the Fisheries Minister on fishers' incomes and fuel subsidies, forward six Speaker's-desk items to committees, and debate the Decentralisation Act amendment and the gang crimes bill.
